Procurement Officer position available in all states NSW, Qld, Vic, & WA

At NEPEAN™ we are proud to be Australia’s leading privately owned engineering, mining services and industrial manufacturing organisation. We have unique capabilities to deliver high value, innovative and sustainable solutions for the world’s leading mining, construction, and transport companies. Over the last 40 years, hard work, technical credibility, and a willingness to tackle very difficult projects have earned NEPEAN an enviable reputation. Today our organisation employs over 1400 people across six continents and distributes products to more than 65 countries.

We service our customers in all states of Australia through multiple businesses in our portfolio: NEPEAN Building and Infrastructure (Galserv, Galintel, Weldlok), NEPEAN Engineering and Innovation, NEPEAN Power, Mining (NEPEAN Longwall), PROK, NEPEAN Conveyors, NEPEAN Transport, Gurtec, Roxon, and NEPEAN Belting Mackay.

We are looking for an experienced and capable Procurement Officer to spearhead the purchasing process from selecting suppliers to ensuring stock optimisation, as well as provide guidance on sourcing and procurement processes.

Position Purpose
The Procurement Officer will manage the purchasing activities, including sourcing suppliers, negotiating contracts, and ensuring cost-effective, timely acquisition of goods and services as required by the company. Ensuring quality control and adhering to the company’s policies and procedures on supply chain management.

The Right Person will:
Plan for the purchase of equipment, services and supplies
Research, evaluate, and maintain a database of qualified suppliers and vendors
Negotiate pricing, contracts, and terms to achieve cost reductions and favorable, high-quality agreements whilst building and maintaining long-term relationships with them
Processing purchase orders (POs), tracking orders, and ensuring timely delivery
Monitor stock levels, maintain accurate purchasing records, and updating inventory data
Ensure all procurement activities comply with legal requirements and company policies. Analyse market trends to optimise procurement strategies
Monitor procurement policies and procedures
Prepare procurement reports

Qualification, Experience, and Skills:
Bachelor’s degree in supply chain management, logistics, or related field
Proven experience in purchasing, procurement, or supply chain management
Experience using supply chain management software and tools
In-depth knowledge of preparing and reviewing contracts, invoicing, and negotiation terms
Strong negotiation, analytical, and communication skills
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, and Access)
Multi-tasking and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks
High attention to detail and organisational skills
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills

If you're ready for your next challenge, please "Apply Now" and forward through your interest today!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super

What You’ll Do 
 
This role is a full-time, permanent position based in Wollongong, NSW (postcode 2500), working within Sicona’s Pilot Plant facility. This role offers an annual salary package from $76,515 - $85,000 plus superannuation commensurate to the candidates experience and level of qualifications. As an entry level position, the candidate will be appropriately trained and supervised to operate within the Plant. You’ll contribute to Sicona’s long-term objective to deliver high performance battery materials at mass market scale, without costing the earth. 
- Support day-to-day operations and maintenance schedules as part of the engineering operations team.    
- Monitoring, adjusting and operating assets at operational sites to meet KPIs.   
- Support the design, procurement, installation, testing and commissioning of current and / or new facilities, as well as turnaround and inspection activities (T&I).   
- Identification of faults through the use of fault-finding techniques followed by troubleshooting and rectification of problems.   
- Contributing to and enhancing continuous improvement initiatives for safety systems.    
- Working in a professional, timely and safe manner following all Sicona and NSW - WHS standards and procedures.    
- Identification, classification, handling and disposal of chemical waste/chemicals according to Sicona’s safety protocols throughout the production process.    
- Reporting incidents, hazards and near misses according to procedures, including conducting investigations as directed by the line manager.   
- Writing of in-depth reports & analysis of operational output reports, providing recommendations & actions and ensuring approved recommendations and actions are implemented or managed.    
- Assist with raw material and final product inventory sample collections  
- Play a key role in the execution of project management activities and planning for projects as required. This includes managing relationships with various stakeholders and suppliers, evaluation of RFQs/RFPs, review of technical bids, and overseeing deliverables to align with project timelines and budgets 
- Support preventative and predictive maintenance programs, including maintenance planning and scheduling. 
- Contribute to project planning and execution by contractor coordination, proposal evaluation and deliverable monitoring. 
- Draft 2D and 3D models of equipment, spare parts and plot plans of facilities using the AutoCAD suite 
- Assist with raw material and final product inventory sample collections 
- Live and breathe our safety-first culture—reporting hazards, near misses, and following WHS, HAZOPs, and risk assessments. Additionally conduct investigations where directed by the line manager and implement rectifications where applicable.   
 
What You will need to Succeed:  
Bachelor’s or higher degree qualification in Chemical, Process, Electrical, Mechanical or other related Engineering field. 
A “solution mindset” and able to manage varying tasks with often changing and competing priorities.  
Familiarity with PFDs, and P&IDs, HAZOP analysis, troubleshooting procedure. 
A team player attitude who can also take initiative independently. 
Adaptable mindset, and ability to adjust on the fly. Priorities change. You roll with it. 
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills together with sound writing skills for reports and proposals. 
A drive to learn, innovate, improve, and be part of something meaningful. 
Strong communication skills and comfort with digital tools like MS Office  
Experience in process operations, materials handling or supply chain in the same or similar setting
 
Even Better If You Have   
Knowledge on process equipment testing and/or commissioning, as well as specifying piping and equipment layout.  
Familiarity with Mass & Energy Balance  
Knowledge of gas cylinders, chemical handling, and analytical equipment. 
Exposure to chemical plant safety frameworks like HAZOP or risk assessments. 
Knowledge of Working in Hazardous Areas Classifications  
First Aid, Fire Safety training, Working at Heights, White Card, Forklift training  
 
Why join us? 
You’ll level up.?Work alongside the brightest minds in clean tech and grow fast. 
You’ll make it real.?Help scale cutting-edge battery materials from lab to production. This is no desk gig. 
Culture with personality.?Zero egos, all drive—just good people solving hard problems together in a team that backs each other. 
We channel the cheetah-honey badger.?Fast, nimble, and absolutely fearless. Equal parts strategic and scrappy. 
Live where it’s beautiful.?Wollongong has great schools, beaches, rainforests, cycle routes, surfing, restaurants, theatres – and just a train ride away from Sydney! 
 
Who We Are 
We develop next-generation silicon-carbon (Si/C) anode materials for lithium-ion batteries—designed to significantly increase energy density and improve fast-charging performance. That’s the kind of breakthrough that gets us out of bed. Check out our website to find out more about our awesome work: https://siconabattery.com. 
We’re a team of engineers, researchers, operators, innovators, dreamers, doers and disruptors who believe climate action shouldn’t be slow—or boring. Whether it's designing new materials in the lab or scaling them in the plant, we work together to transform battery tech and accelerate the electric mobility revolution with the fast, focused, and fearless energy that defines us. 
 
This Is More Than Just a Job 
We’re not here to do things the way they’ve always been done. We’re here to?push boundaries, scale impact, and solve hard problems—together. We're fast, we're fearless, and we're doing it together – One Team, One Dream, One Sicona. 
 
If you're ready to grow, innovate, and get things done - without the fluff - apply now. 
Sicona | Be bold. Be real. Be the cheetah-honey badger.

UE Tech builds software for the local government sector. We develop and maintain two main products: Monitor CRMS, an engagement platform used by councils, and DevCAP, an infrastructure / development contributions (ICP/DCP) administration package — alongside supporting applications and internal tools. We are a small, hands-on development team based in Brunswick.

The role
We are hiring a mid-level developer to work across our product portfolio. Monitor CRMS is currently being re-engineered from a legacy .NET Framework codebase to .NET 10, and you will contribute to both maintaining the existing applications and building out the new platform. This is a full-stack role on a small team — you will work across the back end, database, and front end with limited supervision, and have direct contact with customers to shape what gets built.

What you'll do
Build, maintain, and extend C#/.NET applications (current target framework .NET 10)
Work with SQL Server — writing and optimising queries, schema work, troubleshooting data issues
Develop front-end features in React / Node.js
Deploy and support applications running on Azure
Design and implement complex business-rules logic, configurable workflows, and approval / administration processes
Work directly with customers to understand their needs, clarify requirements, and translate them into technical solutions
Diagnose and fix bugs across existing line-of-business applications
Use AI-assisted development tools as a standard part of the workflow (this is core to how we work)

What we're looking for
1-2 years' commercial software development experience
Solid C# / .NET skills, including maintaining and modernising existing codebases
Working SQL Server experience (querying, schema, performance)
Front-end experience with React and Node.js
Familiarity with Azure-hosted applications
Demonstrated experience building complex line-of-business applications — business-rules-heavy systems, configurable workflows, approvals, or regulatory / statutory process logic
Strong communication skills, with the ability to engage non-technical stakeholders, draw out requirements, and explain technical concepts clearly
Ability to work autonomously across the full stack on a small team
Comfortable adopting AI-assisted development tools day to day
A degree in computer science / software engineering, or equivalent commercial experience

Desirable
Experience modernising legacy .NET Framework applications to current .NET
Experience with CRM, planning, local-government, or public-sector software
Familiarity with development contributions, planning schemes, or similar regulatory domains

Location: In office Brunswick, this is not a remote role.
Work Rights: Applicants must have valid Australian work rights
To apply: Attach your resume and a short cover letter, outlining why you would be a good fit for this role.

Our capabilities span across Telecommunications, Finance, Insurance, health, Public Services, Print / Digital Media, Broadcast and Supply Chain. Dipole Group is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

· Administer, maintain, and support enterprise database environments across production, development, testing, and disaster recovery platforms.

Our Company

TerraCom Limited (ASX: TER) is an Australian based mining resources company with a global footprint, comprising a large portfolio of operating assets in Australia and South Africa within the coal sectors. We are a renowned low-cost producer focused on delivering exceptional outcomes from our high yielding diversified asset portfolio for its investors. TerraCom owns and operates the Blair Athol Coal Mine, in Central Queensland. This open-cut thermal coal operation consists of a full suite of mining activities inclusive of dragline, truck and excavator, dozer push, mine site rehabilitation, coal processing, coal crushing, product haulage and train load-out activities.

The Blair Athol Coal mine is located 24km northwest of the family-friendly township of Clermont in Central Queensland, 120 km northwest of Emerald and 275km southwest of Mackay.

TerraCom supports our people to grow, learn and develop their skills to reach their potential. We offer an exciting working environment, with career progression opportunities, as we truly believe that the capability and performance of our people is key to our success. Blair Athol Mine believes in fostering and nurturing each of our team members by providing them with a safe and enjoyable place to work, along with guidance and support from a leader they can rely upon. Come and play a key role in shaping our future!

The Role

We are currently seeking a highly motivated Surveyor Assistant / Technician to join our team at Blair Athol. You will assist the Surveyor in providing support for survey control to facilitate execution of mine activities including topsoil, stripping, overburden removal, coal mining, drilling/blasting, rehabilitation and associated projects around the mine. The right candidate will also forge a pathway towards further qualifications within the mine engineering team.

Responsibilities of the Role will include:

* Provide survey services and set out control points to ensure the accurate location and layout of work within the limits, offsets, grades, profiles and elevations for all mining related processes in accordance with the mine design criteria
* Conduct survey operations with drones, laser scanners and GPS and process the data to meet the required schedules
* Process survey data accurately and complete volume quantities
* Measure distances, angles and variations across site as directed
* Identify & escalate any non-conformance or processes that require corrective action.

Skills and Experience:

* A good work ethic, great communication skills and a desire to learn and grow
* A strong commitment to safety
* Survey or operational experience within a civil or mining environment
* Ability to prioritise and schedule work
* Ability to accurately measure and interpret data
* Competent user of MS Office tools

Benefits

* A fantastic opportunity to expand your mining career and join a great team offering exposure to all areas of operations and become part of the community in which you work.
* An attractive remuneration package in line with experience.
* An inclusive and supportive team culture.
* Excellent opportunity for career development

Note we thank all applicants for their interest, however any communications will be with short listed candidates only. No agency applications accepted.

Over the last 40 years, hard work, technical credibility, and a willingness to tackle very difficult projects have earned NEPEAN an enviable reputation. Today our organisation employs over 1400 people across six continents and distributes products to more than 65 countries.

We service our customers through multiple businesses in our portfolio: NEPEAN Building and Infrastructure (Galserv, Galintel, Weldlok), NEPEAN Engineering and Innovation, NEPEAN Power, Mining (NEPEAN Longwall), PROK, NEPEAN Conveyors, NEPEAN Transport, Gurtec, Roxon, and NEPEAN Belting Mackay.

We are currently offering a fantastic opportunity for IT Senior Platform Engineer – Microsoft Environment (Global Operations) based in our NSW Office.

THE ROLE

As an IT platform Engineer, you will provide Level 1 and Level 2 support in a Microsoft-centric enterprise environment while also supporting and maintaining the organisation’s Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) platform.

You will act as a key point of contact for end users, taking ownership of incidents and service requests from initial triage through to resolution. In addition to end-user support, you will play an active role in D365 administration, security configuration, user role management, and ongoing platform Maintenance.

Working within Freshservice (ITSM) and leveraging NinjaOne (RMM), you will support Windows endpoints, Microsoft 365 services, Active Directory/Entra ID, Microsoft Defender security tooling, and Dynamics 365 environments. You will contribute to continuous improvement, automation, and operational standardisation across our global IT and business systems landscape.

This role is ideal for a technically capable and customer-focused professional who enjoys solving problems, improving systems, and supporting business-critical platforms in a global support model.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Service Desk & End User Support
Provide remote support for users across Europe and the Americas.
Act as primary point of contact for incidents and service requests logged in Freshservice.
Deliver troubleshooting and resolution for:
Windows 10/11 environments
Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive)
Office applications and collaboration tools
VPN and basic network connectivity issues
Dynamics 365 user access and functional issues
Ensure tickets are categorised, prioritised, and resolved within agreed SLAs.

Dynamics 365 Administration & Platform Support
Administer and support Microsoft Dynamics 365 environments.
Manage D365 security roles, user access, and permission structures.
Configure and maintain:
Security roles and access profiles
Business units and role-based access controls
Environment-level security settings
Support user onboarding/offboarding within D365.
Troubleshoot D365 functional and access-related issues.
Assist with testing, validation, and deployment of D365 updates and changes.
Maintain environment health, performance monitoring, and basic configuration management.
Coordinate with application owners, vendors, and stakeholders for enhancements and issue resolution.
Ensure governance and compliance standards are maintained across D365 environments.

Identity & Access Management
Administer Active Directory and Entra ID (Azure AD).
Manage user lifecycle processes (onboarding, offboarding, access changes).
Configure and support:
Group memberships
Licensing
MFA and Conditional Access
Mailbox management
Align identity controls with D365 security and access models.

Endpoint & RMM Administration
Monitor and manage endpoints using NinjaOne RMM.
Perform patch management, remote remediation, and system monitoring.
Investigate recurring endpoint issues and implement long-term fixes.
Ensure endpoint compliance with security and configuration standards.

Security & Microsoft Defender
Monitor and respond to Microsoft Defender alerts (Endpoint and M365).
Support security best practices including device hardening and vulnerability remediation.
Escalate and coordinate response to suspected security incidents.
Support security posture across D365 through proper role design, least-privilege access, and periodic access reviews.

Problem Management & Continuous Improvement
Perform root cause analysis on recurring incidents (including D365-related issues).
Contribute to process improvement and service optimisation initiatives.
Develop and maintain knowledge base articles, SOPs, and technical documentation.
Identify opportunities for automation within NinjaOne, Microsoft tools, and D365 workflows.
Support governance and platform optimisation initiatives within the D365 ecosystem.

Collaboration & Global Support
Work closely with infrastructure, cybersecurity, application, and business systems teams.
Provide technical guidance to junior support staff when required.
Support change management, system updates, and release cycles (including D365 updates).
Participate in shift coverage aligned with Europe and Americas time zones.

ABOUT YOU

Experience
3–6+ years’ experience in IT Support / Service Desk / End User Computing roles.
Experience supporting a Microsoft-based enterprise environment.
Hands-on experience supporting or administering Microsoft Dynamics 365.
Exposure to global or multi-site support operations is desirable.
Experience with ITSM platforms (Freshservice preferred).
Experience with RMM tools (NinjaOne preferred).

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Strong working knowledge of:
Active Directory & Entra ID (Azure AD)
Microsoft 365 administration
Exchange Online
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
Windows OS administration
MFA and Conditional Access configuration
Dynamics 365 security roles and access management
Role-based access control (RBAC) principles
Basic networking concepts (DNS, DHCP, VPN)

Certifications (Desirable)
Microsoft certifications (MS-900, MD-102, AZ-900 or similar).
Dynamics 365 Fundamentals (MB-910 / MB-920 or similar).

Soft Skills
Strong analytical and troubleshooting mindset.
Excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal).
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a global support model.
Customer-first attitude with a proactive, solution-oriented approach.
High level of accountability and ownership.

If you believe you the right skills, experience and passion for succeeding in this role, please submit your cover letter and resume for consideration.

NEPEAN believes in diversity and is committed to providing Equal Employment opportunities for all applicants. We welcome applicants from all walks of life which also included various socio-economic, cultural, LGBTIQ, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander backgrounds.

Salary: $100,000 per annum + Super

result.description:
IT Systems Analyst
Full-time
Glow Health Care Australia Pty Ltd trading as Glow Health Care Australia
Parramatta, NSW
Salary: $80,000–$100,000 plus superannuation
About the Role
Glow Health Care Australia is seeking an experienced IT Systems Analyst to support and improve the technology systems used across our disability, aged care, home care, allied health and NDIS service operations.
In this role, you will work with managers, employees, external vendors and technology teams to identify business needs, analyse existing systems and implement practical technology solutions. You will help ensure our systems are secure, reliable, compliant and aligned with the organisation’s operational requirements.
Duties and Responsibilities
•	Analyse existing systems, applications and business processes to identify opportunities for improvement. 
•	Consult with stakeholders to gather and document functional and technical requirements. 
•	Translate business requirements into system designs and technical specifications. 
•	Prepare system workflows, process maps, data mappings and functional documentation. 
•	Recommend system enhancements, new applications and improvements to existing platforms. 
•	Coordinate the implementation and rollout of new systems and system upgrades. 
•	Develop and conduct system, integration and user acceptance testing. 
•	Investigate system defects and coordinate resolutions with vendors and development teams. 
•	Support the integration of third-party applications with internal systems and platforms. 
•	Monitor system interfaces and data flows to maintain accuracy and interoperability. 
•	Prepare user guides, technical procedures, training materials and system documentation. 
•	Provide Level 2 and Level 3 support for complex system-related issues. 
•	Assist with staff training and change-management activities during system implementations. 
•	Ensure systems comply with privacy, cybersecurity, data-governance and healthcare requirements. 
•	Conduct post-implementation reviews and recommend further system improvements. 
Skills and Qualifications
•	Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Information Systems or a related discipline. 
•	At least two to three years of relevant experience as a Systems Analyst, Business Systems Analyst or in a similar ICT position. 
•	Experience analysing, implementing and supporting organisational or enterprise systems. 
•	Strong knowledge of requirements gathering, process mapping and technical documentation. 
•	Experience with system integration, APIs, databases and data modelling. 
•	Experience conducting integration testing and user acceptance testing. 
•	Familiarity with SQL, Visio, Jira, Confluence or similar tools. 
•	Understanding of Agile, Waterfall or other software-development methodologies. 
•	Strong analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills. 
•	Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
•	Ability to communicate technical information clearly to non-technical stakeholders. 
•	Knowledge of information security, privacy and data-governance principles. 
•	Experience in healthcare, disability, aged care, community services or NDIS operations is desirable. 
•	ITIL, CBAP, PRINCE2 or similar certification would be advantageous. 
How to Apply
Please submit your résumé and a cover letter outlining your relevant qualifications and experience.
Glow Health Care Australia is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates from all backgrounds.

Data Communications Technician | Brisbane Based | Travel Across QLD | Full-Time Opportunity   Your new company     HAYS has partnered with a well-established and growing communications specialist delivering fibre optic solutions across Queensland. With a strong pipeline of work and a reputation for quality and safety, this organisation prides itself on developing its people and investing in long-term careers.    Your new role     As a Data Communications Technician, you will be working across a mix of local Brisbane sites and remote Queensland projects, installing and maintaining fibre optic communication systems.    This is a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys variety, problem-solving, and working in dynamic environments.   This role involves regular work at heights (6-10 meter transmission structures) and in confined spaces. You must be comfortable working at heights, as this is an essential requirement of the position.    Your day-to-day responsibilities will include: 
 
 Installing, maintaining, and troubleshooting fibre optic and data communication systems 
 Conducting site surveys to assess and deliver tailored communication solutions 
 Reading and interpreting cable plans and technical drawings 
 Performing high-quality installations in line with industry standards 
 Working at heights and within confined spaces in a safe and controlled manner 
 Liaising with clients to understand requirements and deliver effective outcomes 
 Ensuring all work is completed safely, efficiently, and to specification 
 
  What you'll need to succeed     We are open-minded on background - the key focus for us is attitude, aptitude, and a genuine interest in data communications.   You'll ideally bring: 
 
 Experience in telecommunications, electrical, or data communications environments 
 Exposure to fibre optic installation, termination, or testing (highly regarded) 
 ACMA Open Cabling Registration (or willingness to obtain) 
 Current manual driver's licence 
 Ability to work autonomously and as part of a team 
 Strong problem-solving skills and a safety-first mindset 
 Flexibility to travel to remote sites (Monday-Friday) 
  Comfort and capability working at heights (essential)  
 A proactive attitude and willingness to learn and develop 
 
  Desirable but not essential:  
 
 Cert III in Telecommunications 
 MR Licence (or willingness to obtain - support provided) 
 Previous site-based experience in infrastructure, electrical, or comms projects 
 
  What you'll get in return     
 
 Stable, full-time employment with a strong project pipeline   
 Opportunity to work across diverse sites throughout Queensland (home on weekends)   
 Flights, transport, and logistics provided for remote work   
 Ongoing training, mentoring, and career development pathways   
 A supportive team culture that values attitude and effort   
 Competitive salary package

If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.    Please  click here  to apply.
